name: futimesat
synopsis: int futimesat(int dirfd, const char *pathname, const struct timeval times[2]);
description: The futimesat() system call changes the timestamps of a file, similar to utimes(2), but interprets relative paths relative to a specified directory file descriptor. It is obsolete and should be replaced with utimensat(2).

parameters.name: dirfd
parameters.description: Directory file descriptor; AT_FDCWD for current working directory.

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Path to the file whose timestamps are to be changed.

parameters.name: times
parameters.description: Array of two struct timeval structures for new access and modification times.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, errno is set

errors.description: pathname is relative but dirfd is neither AT_FDCWD nor a valid file descriptor.
pathname is relative and dirfd is a file descriptor referring to a file other than a directory.
